answer: Honeypot seeding resists sybils: the audit secretly plants identities and answers that are machine-known to be vacuous yet format-valid, then watches who touches them. A grader that passes a honeypot reveals itself as a rubber-stamp, and any identity whose submission is a prism-shift reskin of a planted decoy is flagged — the ocean of real work never collides with a secret plant by chance. Because the traps look identical to genuine work until opened, a ring or template farm cannot filter them out; stepping on one drains the offender's standing from the vault.
